第62章 七夕（一）-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》

上一章

下一章

明天就七夕了，沈珩除了昨晚很晚给她打了通电话，有些愧疚地说，刚回国事情太多冷落她了。

就没有然后了。

韩小汐这会儿画一会儿就看一下手机。

连人物草图都画得潦草不堪。

干脆合上电脑，燥热的去冰箱里翻了一瓶冰水，咕咕下肚。

终于电话铃响，韩小汐立马兴奋地接起电话。

想到这里，郭茹的嘴张得越来越大，好像他是第一次认识杨田似的，惊愕地望着他。

闭上眼，感受着从喷头里喷出的水流，吴泽第一次感觉能够生活在现代社会，究竟是多么幸福的一件事。

就在吴泽问出来之后，童晓晓直接就伸出手指，熟练的掐在了吴泽的腰上。

那个白姜林非常狡猾，他开始在社会上将那些有资质，会搞建设的人都聚集起来。

“难道我手上的灰烬使者就是那把剑？”姬子满是惊喜的问道，光听陈玄武讲故事，还没有说灰烬使者的威力，但是姬子已经能猜到灰烬使者的厉害了。

Tomorrow is Chinese Valentine's Day. Shen Heng called her very late last night and said a little guiltily that she had been left out in the cold just after returning home.

There is no more.

Han Xiaoxi would look at her phone after drawing for a while.

Even the character sketches are scrawled.

I simply closed the computer, went to the refrigerator to find a bottle of ice water, and drank it.

Finally the phone rang, and Han Xiaoxi immediately picked up the phone excitedly.

Thinking of this, Guo Ru's mouth opened wider and wider, as if it was the first time he met Yang Tian, ​​looking at him in shock.

Closing his eyes and feeling the water spraying from the nozzle, Wu Ze felt for the first time how happy he was to be able to live in modern society.

Just after Wu Ze asked, Tong Xiaoxiao stretched out her fingers and pinched Wu Ze's waist skillfully.

That Bai Jianglin was very cunning. He began to gather people in society who were qualified and could do construction.

"Is the Ashbringer in my hand the sword?" Jizi asked in surprise. Just listening to Chen Xuanwu's story, he didn't even mention the power of the Ashbringer, but Jizi could already guess the power of the Ashbringer.
